title: CalibratedParametersContract
description: Contract-first JSON Schema for companion-exported individualized 1RM, hypertrophy landmarks, and program parameter audits derived from Tier 2 Kalman Filter and Banister models.

version.description: Semantic version of the calibrated parameters schema format.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when calibration was exported.

muscle_landmarks.description: Individualized volume landmarks and localized readiness per muscle group.

exercise_id.description: Foreign key referencing exercises.id in the mobile SQLite database.

calibrated_1rm.description: Estimated true 1-Repetition Maximum strength in kilograms (exp(x_0)). Must be strictly positive.

calibrated_k.description: Individualized movement-specific endurance fatigue exponent (k in w = 1RM * r_eff^-k). Bounded between 0.03 and 0.20.

cov_p00.description: Posterior error covariance element P[0,0] associated with ln(1RM) estimate uncertainty.

cov_p11.description: Posterior error covariance element P[1,1] associated with the endurance exponent k uncertainty.

calibrated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp recording when this exercise parameter calibration was computed.

recommended_swap_exercise_id.description: Suggested replacement exercise ID from parent_exercise_id variant hierarchy.

optimal_rest_seconds.description: Empirically recommended inter-set rest timer in seconds.

asymmetry_ratio.description: Mean fractional unilateral limb repetition asymmetry ratio.

rule_code.description: Program parameter audit code (e.g., REST_TOO_SHORT, JUNK_VOLUME, AXIAL_BOTTLENECK, REP_MONOTONY).

target_id.description: Target identifier: exercise ID, muscle group name, or 'systemic'.

message.description: Actionable explanation of why this audit rule fired.

suggested_parameter.description: Name of parameter suggested for adjustment.

suggested_value.description: Suggested parameter value (numeric, string, or boolean).
